notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature you control without summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Sibling Rivalry by paying {3}{R}, targeting any applicable permanent.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Sibling Rivalry, targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Sibling Rivalry, untapping the creature with Dual Casting attached and creating a tapped Powerstone artifact token.
Repeat from step 3.
